newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Two hurt when plane crashes into house near Zurich.
newsitem.headline: Two hurt when plane crashes into house near Zurich.

text.p: At least two people were hurt when a light aircraft crashed into an apartment block near Zurich Airport in the suburb of Kloten on Thursday night, Swiss police said.
"A twin-engine Cessna crashed into the upper floor of an apartment building in Kloten," a police spokesman told Reuters.
Two people in the plane, which an airport spokesman said was coming from the the Swiss city of Basle, were hurt in the crash shortly after 9 p.m. (1900 GMT).
"As far as we know there were no victims among the residents," the police spokesman said.
Firefighters were on the scene to put out a fire that broke out in the building, which houses several families.
The cause of the crash is being investigated.
